publicationDecision.authorisation: Matt's standing Medicines Watch instruction authorises needed evidence-backed informational additions and corrections to go live without repeat permission.
publicationDecision.scope: Correct the Survodutide evidence note after reviewing the newly available peer-reviewed SYNCHRONIZE-2 abstract. Editorial authorisation is not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-evidence factual review; not clinical approval

fields.summaryToAppend: The peer-reviewed SYNCHRONIZE-2 abstract reports the treatment-regimen estimand at week 76: mean body-weight change was -9.8% with 6.0 mg, -8.2% with 3.6 mg and -3.9% with placebo; the corresponding HbA1c changes were -0.8, -0.9 and -0.2 percentage points.
fields.limitationsTextToReplace: The linked NEJM paper was unavailable in this review.
fields.limitationsReplacement: The PubMed abstract of the peer-reviewed NEJM paper has now been reviewed; the full NEJM article returned HTTP 403 and was not reviewed.
fields.limitationsToAppend: The treatment-regimen estimates are not interchangeable with the sponsor's 13.1% efficacy-estimand figure. The trial enrolled adults with type 2 diabetes and BMI at least 27 kg/m² and was funded by Boehringer Ingelheim, so these results should not be generalised to all people with obesity or treated as sponsor-independent evidence.

additionalEvidence.title: Survodutide Once Weekly in Adults with Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Peer-reviewed PubMed abstract read for design, population, treatment-regimen estimand, body-weight and HbA1c results, adverse-event context and funding. The full NEJM article returned HTTP 403 and was not reviewed; this evidence URL is not automatically content-monitored.

retrieval.scope: The complete PubMed bibliographic record and abstract were reviewed. The full publisher article was inaccessible, so tables, appendices and full methods were not reviewed.

discovery.method: Separate configured-source and topic-based passes. A current-date and broader undated search surfaced the 1 October peer-reviewed SYNCHRONIZE-2 publication after the earlier sponsor and registry review.
discovery.existingWork: The live catalogue, dated receipts and open Watch PRs were checked before selection. This updates the existing Survodutide entry rather than adding a duplicate programme.
discovery.limitations: This bounded evidence correction does not establish complete sponsor or industry coverage and does not renew unrelated source reviews.
discovery.clinicalDecisions: No suitability, dosing, comparative-benefit or safety decision is made. Unsupported clinical conclusions remain awaiting qualified review.
